_conforms_to.spec: harness-unique Root Cause Analysis artifact. Evidence-chain pattern referenced from Ericsson multivendor agentic AI demo (Bibliography ref 35).
_conforms_to.spec_section: Diagnostic substrate output, per architecture_v3.mmd RCA node
_conforms_to.schema_role: Validates the Root Cause Analysis output flowing from the 3 domain agents (Platform, RAN, Hardware) into the Remediation Router.

title: RCA
description: Cross-domain evidence chain emitted by the diagnostic substrate before routing. Aggregates findings from the Platform, RAN, and Hardware domain agents into a single structured artifact the Router consumes.

fault_id.description: References the originating FaultPayload.fault_id. Pattern aligns with FaultPayload.fault_id and AuditEvent.event.correlatedEventId so all three schemas accept both date-based ids (flt-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN) and short codes (flt-D-001, flt-E-reject-001).

evidence.description: All findings from all domain agents, in chronological order.

candidate_classifications.description: Ranked list of taxonomy matches with confidence. The Router selects the top entry unless ambiguous.

taxonomy_match.description: Must match a taxonomy id from harness/taxonomy.yaml.

rationale.description: One-sentence explanation of why this classification is supported by the evidence.

knowledge_base_lookups.description: Optional. Cites RAG playbooks or vendor knowledge base entries consulted during RCA.
